gen-dafont-visitor-manrope: Manrope draws every curve with a bright gap at its mouth. Visitor gets a gaping e and stubby ascenders up top, and below it that single-width line keeps paragraphs gliding along without a snag.
gen-gf-funnel-display-montserrat: Tangled spaghetti strokes, all one width, make Funnel Display loud up top. And Montserrat leads the eye through generous white space before each curve, so paragraphs glide by.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-bespoke-sans: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open. What stands out most is modulation: Gabarito has none, while Bespoke Sans keeps it low and refined.
gen-gf-goldman-archivo: Widely set letters with generous clearance give Goldman its swagger up top. Archivo handles the reading, its curves opening outward and its commanding x-height carrying the text along.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-asap: Widely spaced letters with no weight shift give Bushcraft its artistic feel. The best quality is the closed look of Bushcraft against the open arcs and near-capital body height of Asap.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads friendly, with curvy monoline letters that feel pleasantly unclamped. Conthrax leads with a wide-mouthed a and tall bodies, so the page feels like following a single thread.
gen-dafont-dogica-fs-supreme: Wide tracking defines Dogica, whose lowercase rises close to the capitals. Supreme runs a crisp, heavy-looking band of text beneath, its letters held open rather than curled shut, so the two feel sturdy together.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-manrope: Eight Bit Dragon strides across widely spaced letters, its gently modulated strokes adding adventure up top. Manrope, meanwhile, keeps a single unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions and handles the everyday reading.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-satoshi: Fast and aggressive, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart over short ascenders and big bowls. Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and constant-width strokes, and that gap in stroke variation is the pairing's best quality.
gen-dafont-galaxy-switzer: Galaxy runs uninterrupted line width through a dense, tall lowercase band, with loose letterfit. Switzer brings tubular, wire-like letterforms and a tall waist line, with c tips that never creep toward touching.
